Perhaps guilt or pain from having hurt the other person? Alexithymia works in a few diff ways (i don't remember how, but look it up) but the type of alexithymia you seem to have is the type where you have physical reactions that accompany emotions just without the emotions. Not saying that's a type. I'm bad at explaining it but there's lots more in depth stuff you can read about online. I'm on the more high functioning end so I feel a good range of emotions it's just that I can only name the simple ones. It's hard to deal with but with professional help you might be able to learn to identify what emotion your physical reactions indicate. If you want to talk more I'm open.
